Hybrid\\u0027 (case-insensitive, one shared pattern), and only when that line appears before any similar-vehicles or recommended-cars heading on the page, so a padded card further down never decides it; a page with no such line behaves exactly as today; proven by tests over fixtures cut from the recorded Autotrader pages detail-1.txt, detail-5.txt, and detail-17.txt (accepted) and a gas Corolla page (rejected)\u0022,\u0022The extraction schema (src/Odonomics/Extraction/schema.json) and ExtractionClient\\u0027s record gain a nullable fuelType field described as the fuel or drivetrain type as the page states it (Gas, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid, Electric), read from a spec line and null when absent; the prompt\\u0027s rules and injection guard are unchanged; the walk stores nothing new for it yet but logs it in the per-page console line so a later task can persist it; the deterministic spec-line check, not the field, is what decides the match\u0022,\u0022The wrong-model drop reason for a hybrid query names what was checked (\\u0027no Hybrid in title, trim, or spec line\\u0027) so a future miss is diagnosable from the summary; the README\\u0027s walk text on the hybrid match (or docs/walk.md if the docs split has landed) says the spec line counts too; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-59 on 2026-09-26 during walk run 5 (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found), verified by the orchestrator against ~/Library/Application Support/Odonomics/walks/autotrader/20260926-121057/corolla-hybrid/: the summary read \\u0027autotrader / Toyota Corolla Hybrid: 25 pages, 2 saved, 23 dropped (22 wrong model, 1 no VIN)\\u0027 on a search stating 41 Matches with fuelTypeGroup=HYB working; the pages are titled \\u0027Certified 2026 Toyota Corolla SE FWD\\u0027, \\u0027Used 2023 Toyota Corolla LE FWD\\u0027, \\u0027Certified 2024 Toyota Corolla LE FWD\\u0027 (never Hybrid), and 24 of 25 carry the spec line \\u0027Hybrid: Gas/Electric\\u0027 (detail-1.txt line 29, detail-5.txt line 25, detail-17.txt line 27); extraction returns model Corolla and trim LE, so the matcher\\u0027s ContainsHybridText fails and PR #50\\u0027s title backstop (\\u0027\\u003Cyear\\u003E \\u003Cmake\\u003E \\u003Cbase model\\u003E Hybrid\\u0027) never matches. Autotrader / Camry Hybrid pre-2025 cars will hit the same. Code: src/Odonomics/Sources/ListingQuery.cs holds MatchesExtractedVehicle, MatchesWalkedPage, TitleNamesHybrid, and the TitleLine regex (PR #50); the walk calls MatchesWalkedPage in src/Odonomics/Cli/Commands/WalkCommand.cs with the page body text; the drop reason text is built just below that call; src/Odonomics/Extraction/schema.json and ExtractionClient.cs define the extraction fields. Keep both backstops deterministic over page text; the extraction field is informational for now. Do not touch the run skill file in the project home; the orchestrator updates
